name: agent-memory
description: Persistent, searchable Agent Memory with global/project scopes, compiled recall, and automatic graph links.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent scoped memory with compiled recall and graph links
interface.longDescription: A persistent memory plugin for Codex. It stores durable global preferences and project-specific workflows, supports deep memories, lite indexes, automatic/manual graph links, semantic search when embeddings are configured, lazy no-op reads for uninitialized projects, model-gated writes, and an interactive init flow for OpenAI API credentials.
